# Copilot instructions for this repo

Read `docs/agent-protocol.md` before making changes.

## Must-follow rules
- Never work on `main`.
- Check for an issue first.
- Make sure the issue has a milestone.
- Create a branch before changing files.
- Open a PR when the work is ready.
- Link the issue in the PR.
- Use clear, simple wording.

## When writing or editing
- Keep edits small and focused.
- Prefer the existing project style.
- Do not rename things unless needed.
- Explain changes in plain language.
- Avoid heavy jargon.

## PR reminder
A good PR should say:
- what changed
- why it changed
- how it was tested
- which issue it closes
